thread:
Maya Chen: Hi @Jonathan — quick heads up, I need to raise an accessibility/comfort concern. The shared desk area on 4F gets really warm in the afternoons and it's triggering heat intolerance for me. I'm starting to have headaches and it's affecting my focus and output.
Jonathan Park: Thanks for flagging, Maya. Sorry to hear that. Do you want to DM me details or post here so People Ops can loop in?
Maya Chen: Posting here so it's on record. I tried switching desks but teammates are protective of their spots. I can bring a small personal fan but I'd prefer a more durable fix.
Alex Rivera: @Maya are you able to work hybrid afternoons for now (start earlier) or do you need a physical change? We can try moving you to the north side where it's cooler.
Maya Chen: I can shift hours short-term, but long-term I need a consistent workspace. Also wanting to understand ADA process so I don't jeopardize my performance review — I had 2 late tasks last week because of the headaches.
Samira Patel: Hi Maya — thanks for raising this. People Ops can start the interactive process. We typically need a brief note from a clinician for formal accommodations, but we can provide interim measures immediately (fan, cooling pad, or desk swap). Also we can flag manager coaching as not disciplinary; we'll coordinate a supportive plan.
Maya Chen: Appreciate that. What's the timeline for interim measures?
People Ops (bot): @Maya — Submitted request to facilities for a portable fan and to facilities for a desk relocation assessment. ETA 24-48 hrs. Ticket #FAC-20274
Jonathan Park: I'll hold off on formal performance feedback until we have a plan. Maya, can you share which afternoons are worst? I can reassign tasks or adjust deadlines temporarily.
Maya Chen: Afternoons ~2pm-5pm are the worst, especially after long meetings. A seat near the window or by the stairwell helps.
Alex Rivera: I'll check the seating map. If the north-side bench is free Friday I can reserve it for you.
Samira Patel: Next steps from People Ops: 1) interim: fan + priority seat lookup (today), 2) if you want formal accommodation we can accept a clinician note and document an ADA plan (2-5 business days), 3) inform manager coaching plan to be collaborative (we'll draft a note). Would you like us to submit the manager note template?
Maya Chen: Yes please submit template. Also can we add a line to ensure coaching conversations are paused until accommodation is in place? Not paused forever, just until the physical issue is mitigated.
People Ops (bot): @Maya — Sending manager note template now.
People Ops (bot): ```To: Jonathan Park
From: People Ops
Subject: Interim support for team member accommodation request

Jonathan — Please coordinate temporary schedule and seating adjustments for Maya Chen while People Ops arranges accommodations. Please treat this as a supportive measure, not a performance action. We'll follow up with an ADA plan and documentation requirements within 5 business days.```
Jonathan Park: Thanks folks. Maya, I'll update my 1:1 agenda to focus on support and defer any notes related to performance for now. I'm available to meet 30m after standup tomorrow.
Maya Chen: Thanks @Jonathan and team. I feel better already having a plan. I'll send a short note from my clinic when I have it, but please proceed with interim measures now. :relieved:
Samira Patel: Noted. We'll keep this thread for tracking. If there are any changes ping me or DM.
